title: Onboarding patterns lab — standup notes
content:
Meeting: Onboarding patterns lab — weekly standup
Date: 2026-11-04 10:00-10:30 PT
Location: Zoom / #dx-onboarding
Facilitator: Marisol
Attendees: Marisol, Noah, Evelyn, Samir, (quick drop-ins: Priya, Devon)

Purpose: look for quick wins to reduce time-to-first-success for new engineers and external integrators. Focus this week on: 1) Quickstart templates (Python + node), 2) sample app discovery flow, 3) SDK error surface simplification.

Quick updates (90s each)
- Marisol: Quickstart A/B experiment running; initial cohort (10 devs) on variant B with guided CLI had 40% faster first-response success. Need to expand to 50 devs next week.
- Noah: Samples repo restructure branch ready for review. Changed top-level samples to be domain-focused (chatbot, reranker, embeddings) rather than language-first. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/pull/113
- Evelyn: Docs: trimmed quickstart to sub-10 minute path; removed blocking stub where users had to create API key manually (moved to CLI-assisted flow). Waiting on CLI flag from infra (DX-4312).
- Samir: SDK: shipping small ergonomics change to response object (flattening 'meta' into root) — pushing change request to SDK PR 842. Breaking change but we will provide compatibility shim in the 1.x->2.x upgrade path.

Notes / discussion
1) CLI-assisted onboarding (Marisol, Evelyn)
- We observed many drop-offs at the API-key step. CLI flow that creates a scoped ephemeral token via console API reduced friction in the pilot.
- Security note: token creation requires a scoped service principal. We need platform sign-off (security & infra) to add this to public CLI. Action: Marisol to file a short security design (one-pager) and ping infra. Linked: DX-4312.

2) Samples discovery UX (Noah)
- New structure makes it easier for newcomers to find a 'task' sample (e.g., embeddings for search). But it exposes duplication across examples. We discussed adding a small shared utils package that samples import to avoid copy/paste.
- Concern: packaging friction for external contributors. Proposal: include tiny bootstrap script that creates local symlinks for shared-utils.
- Decision: proceed with shared-utils as a flat python package inside /samples/shared_utils for now. Post-launch, consider extracting to a separate repo if usage grows.

3) SDK surface changes & compatibility (Samir)
- Flattening response fields simplifies quickstart docs and examples. Major SDK PR will be labelled "opt-shallow-resp" and have an automated migration guide (scripting sed replacements + small compatibility wrapper).
- Action: Samir to draft migration script and example before merging. He estimates 3 dev days.

Blockers
- Infra guardrail needed for CLI token creation (security review). Blocker for Evelyn and Marisol to fully enable CLI-assisted quickstart across org.
- Samples CI flake: integration tests for samples sometimes time out on small ephemeral infra in CI. Noah to add retry/backoff and increase job timeout.

Decisions made
- Incremental rollout: enable new quickstart variant B (CLI-assisted) for larger cohort next week but keep classic flow as opt-out for stability.
- Shared sample utils will live in samples repo under shared_utils for now.

Action items (owners & rough ETA)
- Marisol: Draft security one-pager for CLI token flow, attach to DX-4312 and ping infra/security. ETA: 2026-11-06.
- Samir: Write migration script + add compatibility wrapper to SDK PR 842. ETA: 2026-11-11.
- Noah: Update samples CI (retry + timeout) and open follow-up PR for shared_utils layout. ETA: 2026-11-08.
- Evelyn: Update quickstart docs to reference new CLI flow and add a short troubleshooting section for common ENV mistakes. ETA: 2026-11-09.

Open questions / follow-ups
- How will we measure long-term retention impact from the CLI-assisted quickstart? (Marisol) Proposal: instrument metric 'new-dev: completed-first-flow' and track 7-day retention for 90 days. Owner: Marisol + analytics.
- Should shared-utils be published as a package (pip/npm) for external users? Risk: versioning overhead. We deferred until internal usage reaches 5+ samples.

Notes to self (informal)
- Try to get a quick showing of CLI flow in next week's all-hands (5 minute demo) — it helps the sales/dev advocates.
- Remember to capture short video of onboarding for marketing.

Next meeting: 2026-11-11 10:00 PT
